verdict.rationale: PostHog's official hosted MCP server exposes a Dashboards tool category (18 tools) alongside insight, SQL and trend tooling, and agents can invoke tools on demand through CLI-mode `exec`/`call`. First-party agents (PostHog AI and the wizard) are documented to create insights and dashboards, and the same agent stack is reachable from any MCP client. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the dashboard create/add-insight MCP tool names (only `dashboard-get` is named), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent building a dashboard end-to-end via MCP or API.
